documentation.content: The worker stopped calling a cut-out (background removal) service for a while because its calls kept failing. Batches slow down or fall back to the other cut-out service while this lasts. First open the catalog-matting and catalog-matting-gpu services in Cloud Run and look at their errors and recent revisions. Then search Logs Explorer for "matting_breaker" to see which service opened the breaker.
documentation.subject: Catalog: cut-out service breaker open
